tagline: One home for music, audiobooks and live radio.
description:
mvmAudio brings music, chapter-based audiobooks and HTTPS radio to the mvmOS desktop and a responsive Apps Hub page. Every listener keeps independent progress, favourites, bookmarks and playlists.

Library folders
Add a folder from this server or a connected folder shared by another mvmOS. Audio stays in place: subfolders become albums or books, files follow natural chapter order, and scans read tags and covers. Refresh manually or set a scan interval; removing a source leaves its original files alone.

Listening
Start or pause from a cover, open the expanded player and manage the queue. Speed, sleep timers, shuffle, repeat and chapter controls stay available while browsing. Open an audio file from File Manager in the same player without adding it to the library.

Personal libraries
Playlists can combine library items and be shared with selected profiles. Premium optionally enables personal uploads with administrator-set allowances; those uploads are off by default.
capabilities: Separate music, audiobook and radio libraries with search and genre filters.
Administrator-managed common library and public playlists.
Independent chapter, position, percentage and remaining time per listener.
Playback speed, bookmarks, sleep timer, shuffle, repeat and queue.
Personal favourites, listening history and playlists shared with selected Apps Hub profiles.
Authenticated seeking and streaming of private audio files.
Mobile interface and Media Session controls for supported browsers.
Bundled audio inspection with no FFmpeg, system packages or additional installation steps.
Read embedded metadata and cover art automatically without changing original audio.
Search MusicBrainz and Open Library directly from your installation, preview matches and apply selected fields.
Manual cover upload, source attribution and per-title metadata editing, with no API keys.
Quick play and pause on library covers, an expanded player, and a live queue with play-next, add, reorder, remove, clear, shuffle and repeat controls.
Library folders on this server or another mvmOS, with manual or scheduled scans and no copying of the audio.
Natural chapter ordering, automatic tag and cover reading, and removal of records for files no longer present.
Upload files or folders into a chosen library location through the shared uploader.
Open audio files directly from File Manager without importing them into the library.
requirements: A browser that supports the audio formats in your library.
